test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The comedian's jokes are so bad that audiences__ usually groaning instead of__ laugh.
solution:
The correct answer is "**usually groan instead of.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the part "usually groaning instead of."
 
• **The use of the base form of the verb "laugh" suggests that the sentence is in simple present tense.**
 
• **Thus, the use of the present participle form of the verb "groan" i.e. "groaning" is incorrect.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "usually groan instead of."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
